verdict.summary_en: Korean delivery note DN-261025-827 dated 2026.10.25 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, against PO 4500318718. One line: CMP-GAM-001 Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6, 70 000 PCS in 70 boxes, total weight 910 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. The remarks field is empty. There are no corrections or strike-throughs. A handwritten receiver signature 'Meyer K.' and the supplier's red company stamp are present.
observations: Red round stamp 'HWASEONG MEMORY CO LTD' with a star overlaps the unit (PCS) and box-count cells and part of the header. The values are still readable. The stamp contains no date.
Handwritten signature 'Meyer K.' on the receiver (인수자) line. No receiving date is written next to it.
Quantity is written as '70 000' with a space as the thousands separator, which I read as 70000. The box count 70 is consistent with the 박스: 70 total.
The note shows no ordered quantity and no prices, so I could not compare the delivered quantity with the order.
